scripts.size: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.wrangler/size',{recursive:true,force:true})" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/size && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib'),d='.wrangler/size/';let raw=0,gz=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){if(f.endsWith('.map')||f==='README.md')continue;const b=fs.readFileSync(d+f);raw+=b.length;gz+=z.gzipSync(b).length}console.log('raw',raw,'gzip',gz,gz<2800000?'OK':'OVER 2800000');if(gz>=2800000)process.exit(1)"
